The '''kentril''' was a [[Species/Legends|species]] of carnivorous [[Rodent/Legends|rodent]]. It had claws and a powerful bite. [[Mennac Vanderijar|Mennac]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] had a barely domesticated kentril as a pet and attack beast.
